comment: Access control objects that RHACS is expected to install by default
when the provider is absent, reusing objects already present. The auth provider trusts the
cluster's client CA, so its certificate identities are Kubernetes identities:
a role mapping matches the certificate common name with the 'name' attribute.

permissionSet.name: OpenShift Prometheus Metrics Reader
permissionSet.description: For OpenShift Prometheus: read access to Administration for /metrics scraping

accessScope.name: OpenShift Central Cluster
accessScope.description: Scoped to clusters labeled stackrox.io/central-colocated (set automatically by the operator)

role.name: OpenShift Prometheus Metrics Reader
role.description: Maps OpenShift Prometheus service account to /metrics read access
